q: Make one variable of each of the four basic types and print the value next to its type.
code:
count   = 42
average = 61.5
name    = "Kavya"
passed  = True
for v in [count, average, name, passed]:
    print(v, type(v).__name__)
out:
42 int
61.5 float
Kavya str
True bool

q: Ask for a number and print its square, its cube, and whether it divides by 3.
code:

print("square:", n ** 2)
print("cube  :", n ** 3)
print("divides by 3:", n % 3 == 0)

number: 9
square: 81
cube  : 729
divides by 3: True
